mapper.select: select t.empId ,t.token,e.email,t.tokenExpiryDate from ConfirmationToken t inner join EmployeeInfo e on e.empId=t.empId where e.email=#{user.email}
mapper.insert: insert into ConfirmationToken(token,tokenCreationDate,tokenExpiryDate,empId) values(#{token},#{tokenCreationDate},#{tokenExpiryDate},(select empId from EmployeeInfo where email=#{user.email}))
mapper.update: update ConfirmationToken t inner join EmployeeInfo e on t.empId=e.empId set t.token=#{token},t.tokenCreationDate=#{tokenCreationDate},t.tokenExpiryDate=#{tokenExpiryDate} where e.email=#{user.email}
